caption:
A du'a for every hard conversation.

Before facing a heavy task, Musa asked his Lord to put his heart at ease, make his task easy and loosen the knot from his tongue so that people would understand him. Keep these words close before your next exam, interview or difficult talk.

Surah Taa-Haa 20:25-28

Who do you know with a big day ahead? Send this to them.

#quranreels #duaforease #prophetmusa #quranrecitation

Recitation: Mishary Alafasy
alt_text: He said, “My Lord, reassure my heart for me; and ease my task for me; and loosen the knot from my tongue; so that they may understand my speech (Surah Taa-Haa 20:25-28)
